Editor's note—
Ord. No. 4365, § 1, adopted November 19, 2012
, amended article II in its entirety to read as herein set out. Former article II,
               §§ 94-31—94-42, pertained to construction and repair of sidewalks, etc., and derived
               from §§ 21-9—21-11.2 of the 1960 Code; §§ 30-21—30-32 of the 1981 Code; Ord. No. 2961,
               § 1, 3-15-1993; Ord. No. 3048, § 1, 2-21-1994; Ord. No. 3860, §§ 1—9, 3-15-2004;
Ord. No. 4042, § 6, 12-11-2006
.
Charter reference—
Construction of sidewalks, etc., not subject to protest, § 11.9.
State Law reference—
Power of city council to provide for the construction and maintenance of sidewalks,
               curbs and gutters, C.R.S. § 31-15-702.
